description: Downstream fan-out coverage: two same-kind sinks attached downstream both receive the full payload and each records it under the same-kind label; a same-kind sink and a foreign standard logger attached together each format the entry their own way; the foreign standard logger surfaces the correct single-letter severity across the severity range; suppression skips the primary sink yet the entry is still forwarded to an attached same-kind downstream sink, which records it; a foreign probe logger observes a non-suppressed entry with the skip flag inactive; and a same-kind sink accumulates a running count across multiple forwarded entries.
